item.title: Record cyclosporiasis outbreak tests the response of a 'weakened' health system
item.description: From state and local food-safety response to the federal health agencies that fund that work, a record-breaking year for cyclosporiasis cases runs up against the Trump administration's cuts last year.

item.title: 3 things to know about the $40 trillion federal debt
item.description: The U.S. federal debt hit a record $40 trillion this week. The debt has doubled since 2017, and just paying interest on the accumulated debt now costs the government more than $1 trillion a year.

item.title: What to know about Dr. Heidi Overton, Trump's pick to lead the FDA
item.description: Dr. Heidi Overton is currently working as a White House policy aide. If confirmed, she would lead an agency of 18,000 staffers who study and regulate food, drugs, medical devices, tobacco and more.

item.title: D.C.'s IndyCar race will zoom past museums. Some worry it could harm the art inside
item.description: Sunday's course takes high-speed cars right past the National Gallery of Art and three Smithsonian museums. Art experts worry about the works inside, but organizers say they don't expect damage.

item.title: Privacy advocates call on Maryland to investigate data brokers
item.description: Maryland has one of the strictest data privacy laws in the country. But privacy advocates allege that data brokers are violating the law by selling data to police and federal immigration agencies.
